create_configuration_longcat_flash: create a LongcatFlashConfig instance to initialize a LongCat Flash model configuration
initialize_model_with_longcat_flash_conf: initialize a LongcatFlashModel from a LongcatFlashConfig configuration object
access_model_configuration: access the model configuration via model.config after model instantiation
configure_moe_expert_routing: configure MoE routing with moe_topk, n_routed_experts, zero_expert_num, and expert_ffn_hidden_size parameters
set_attention_and_rope_parameters: set attention parameters including qk_nope_head_dim, qk_rope_head_dim, kv_lora_rank, and rope_parameters
